home.fix_body: Some settings were turned off. Your parent will see this.
home.fix_title: NurtureNet needs a setting back on
home.offline: No connection. Your rules still work. We will update them when you are online.
home.r_exam: Study time. Only study apps are open.
home.r_limit: Today's screen time is used up.
home.sos_note: Holding this tells your family where you are.

lock.blocked_app: This app is off right now
lock.until_parent: Your parent will turn it back on.
lock.why: Your parent set these rules. They can change them in the NurtureNet app.

notif.body: Your parent set rules for this phone. Tap to see them.
notif.title: NurtureNet is on

pair.failed: That code did not work. Ask your parent for a new one.
pair.invalid: The code has 6 numbers. Check it and try again.
pair.label: 6-digit code
pair.note: The code works once, for 15 minutes.
pair.sub: Ask your parent to open NurtureNet on their phone, go to Settings, then Link a phone.
pair.title: Enter the code

perm.access: Pause apps when the rules say so
perm.access_why: NurtureNet uses the Accessibility setting only to see which app is on screen, so it can show a rest page at bedtime, school or prayer. It does not read what you type, your messages or your passwords. In the list, tap NurtureNet and switch it on.
perm.battery_why: Stops the phone from switching NurtureNet off to save battery.
perm.loc_note: Without location, your parent cannot see where you are and SOS cannot share it.
perm.loc_why: So your parent can see you are safe. Choose "Allow all the time" so it keeps working when the app is closed.
perm.need: Switch on the first two to continue
perm.notif_why: NurtureNet always tells you when it is on.
perm.sub: Switch these on one by one. Come back here after each one.
perm.title: Let NurtureNet work
perm.usage_why: So NurtureNet can count your screen time. Android will open a list: find NurtureNet and switch it on.

sos.no_loc: Could not find your location. Turn on location, or call someone now.
sos.queued: No network. Your alert will send as soon as you are back online.
sos.sent: Help is on the way. Your family has been told where you are.

welcome.cta: I have a code from my parent
welcome.no_read: NurtureNet does not read your messages, photos or passwords. It always shows a notice when it is on.
welcome.sos_sub: Hold the red button and your family is told where you are.
welcome.sub: Your parent chose it to help you use your phone in a healthy way. Here is what it does.
welcome.time_sub: Like time for sleep, school and prayer.
welcome.title: Hi! This phone uses NurtureNet.
welcome.where_sub: So your parent knows you are safe.
